title: Caloric restriction modulates genome-wide somatic mutation in mice.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: SRA (Sequence Read Archive) study SRP713271 has 227 entries; one run (BioProject PRJNA1483214) is 'Somatic NanoSeq of Mouse 32 Cerebellar neurons', NovaSeq X, 495 Gb bases / 156 GB on disk. GSE288730 (text-mined) is a different lab's single-cell chromatin atlas reused as a reference, not this paper's data. Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500 and supplementary files were not retrievable; Zenodo/Dryad search on the DOI found nothing.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Tissues (bulk liver, bulk kidney, hepatocytes, cerebellar neurons), duplex sequencing method, and the caloric-restriction effects on substitution, indel and SBS5 (a mutational signature) burdens come from the abstract only. Whether processed mutation-call tables exist in a Cell supplement is unknown.

a1_downloadable.note: Only raw duplex reads found in SRA (~156 GB for one run checked); no processed mutation-call table found in GEO, Zenodo, Dryad or Europe PMC. Checked in repositories, not files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Mutation burden per sample would have to be constructed by running a duplex-sequencing variant-calling pipeline (NanoSeq) on raw reads; no label column exists in anything found.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs are raw sequencing reads, which project rules forbid downloading.

a5_enough_rows.note: The independent unit is the mouse; one run label reaches 'Mouse 32', suggesting tens of mice across diet groups, far below 400. Exact count not verified.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~156 GB per run (one checked), 227 SRA entries
a6_fits_laptop.note: Raw data is terabyte-scale; reprocessing needs a cluster.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Full text unavailable, so sample counts could not be compared.

a8_label_provenance.note: Mutation calls would come from direct duplex sequencing measurement, not another model's predictions.

honest_claim_h3: With tens of mice and only raw reads available, no model could claim more than a group-level diet effect, which the paper already reports.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a mouse's diet, tissue and the local genome context to predict how many somatic mutations accumulate there.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-mouse, per-tissue mutation calls with surrounding DNA sequence and transcription status; number of examples unknown because no processed calls were found.
plain_idea.predict: Mutation burden or mutation probability per genomic region, measured by high-fidelity duplex DNA sequencing (both DNA strands read so errors cancel out).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Ageing researchers could learn which genome regions caloric restriction protects, but the paper already answers this at group level.

ml_idea: Region-level model of somatic mutation probability under caloric restriction versus normal diet; not feasible without processed mutation calls.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; raw reads (~156 GB per run checked) put reprocessing beyond a laptop.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check whether the Cell supplement holds per-mutation call tables; if not, project is dead.

verdict_reason: Only raw duplex-sequencing reads (~156 GB per run) were found, with no processed mutation table, and the independent unit is tens of mice, so A1, A2, A3, A5 and A6 fail.
